title: Special Judicial Magistrate Vacancy At Various Districts Of Uttar Pradesh
description: The High Court of Judicature at Allahabad invites application for the post of Special Judicial Magistrate under Aligarh, Banda, Etah, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Meerut, and Sonbhadra districts of Uttar Pradesh. Name of the Post: Special Judicial Magistrate No. of Post: 01 (One) each Essential Qualification and Experience A person shall not be qualified for appointment as a Special Judicial Magistrate unless he/she: (a) holds or has held any post under the Government; and (b) possesses the degree of law
